# Chatbot Widget Project Instructions

## Project Overview
A modern chatbot UI widget with Socket.io real-time communication, similar to Nobrokers chat widget.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
- Real-time Communication: Socket.io Client
- Backend: https://chatbotapi-prod-v1-bhcsdnbbdygjhpe9.southindia-01.azurewebsites.net

## Project Setup Checklist

- [x] Create project files and structure
- [ ] Install dependencies (Socket.io client)
- [ ] Configure Socket.io connection
- [ ] Test chat functionality
- [ ] Deploy widget

## Development Notes
- Socket.io connection URL: https://chatbotapi-prod-v1-bhcsdnbbdygjhpe9.southindia-01.azurewebsites.net
- Widget can be embedded as standalone HTML file or npm module
- Responsive design for mobile and desktop
